notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Resource Capacity Indicator:

 We’ve added a bar that displays the maximum resource capacity your ship can carry, helping players manage their collections more effectively.


Upgrade Shop: 

We’ve introduced a shop where players can expand their resource storage capacity and purchase radar upgrades to locate more distant planets.


Discovered Planets Counter: 

The planet list on the left side of the screen has been replaced with a counter showing how many planets have been discovered, streamlining the interface while keeping players informed.


Orbit Visual Effect: 

A new visual effect has been added to planet orbits to alert players when they’re approaching a planet, encouraging them to slow down their rocket to avoid collisions.


Low Resource Warning: 

When Earth’s resources drop below 200, a red effect on the left-side indicator will warn players to return quickly and replenish Earth with the collected resources.


Expanded Game Objective: 

The game’s objective has been expanded! In addition to discovering planets, players must now gather resources from these planets and bring them back to Earth, challenging themselves to sustain life on Earth for as long as possible with the available resources.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
A radar has been added that appears while the player holds the spacebar. This radar shows nearby planets, with a currently small radius of operation. We are working on a way for the player to upgrade and increase the radar's search capacity in order to make it easier to discover more distant planets
